 Created PCR mix for 4 different DNA sequences and 5 controls:
 DNA Sequences:
 6-His imcherry (708bp)
 mcp-1 + HlyA(713bp)
 mcp-1 + PelB (536bp)
 mcp-1 expression
 Controls:
 DNA only
 FP only
 No DNA
 Primers only
 RP only
 No primers.
 The PCR (Total 25 µl) mix was created by adding the following ingredients in order:
1. NF H2O: 8.9 µl
2. Buffer: 5 µl
3. dNTP mix: 0.5 µl
4. Forward primer: 0.2 µl
5. Reverse primer: 0.2 µl
6. DNA sequence: 10 µl
 PCR was run by the following process:
Denaturalisation: 95oC/98oC – 2min
Annealing (30 times): 95oC - 20s; Tm(67oC) – 30s;
Extension: 72oC-20s/kb -> 10min
 Gel Electrophoresis (Gel preparation and electrophoresis)
1% Agarose Gel(1X); Heated in the oven for 30-45s, till transparency is achieved.
Loading Order:
1.Gene Ruler
2.imCherry
3.mcp-1 Hly-A
4.mcp-1 Hly-A
Blank 6.mcp expression
7. Control (no DNA)
8.Control (no primer)
Gene ruler: 1µl loading dye + 1µl gene ruler + 1µl NF H2O
2-8: 2µl loading dye + 10µl DNA (PCR mix)
